The lemma 'You took pledges from your brothers without cause, and you stripped the clothing of the naked' is Job 22:6 LXX (Ἠνεχύραζες δὲ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου διακενῆς, ἀμφίασιν δὲ γυμνῶν ἀφείλου), both halves of which are in the Greek; the flags came from chunk boundaries, as did the doxology. John 8:12 is a correct apparatus identification of Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου. Πότερον οὐχί introduces a question expecting 'yes', so 'Is it not the Lord who teaches…?' is right. 'Only the wise God knows these' renders ὁ μόνος σοφὸς οἶδε Θεός (cf. Rom 16:27). The rest (κατὰ λόγον, θεωρία, articles, aspect of ἐκδύσω) is style.
